interpretation: Explicit coarse hand estimates of named residential/industrial/valley sectors on the actual municipal street/satellite maps. The printed action-area fills are context, not falsely relabeled complete quarter boundaries.

areas.name: Béketelep
areas.note: Estate along the visible northwest city valley; close to action-areaVI but including the adjoining built-up strip. Printed action boundary used only as context.

areas.name: Városközpont
areas.note: Broad built-up city-centre sector, guided by the centre action-area and adjacent actual street blocks. Not merely the smaller development action polygon.

areas.name: Vasvár
areas.note: Residential/park corridor beside the recreation-zone outline, manually extended to the named built-up sector.

areas.name: Gyújtó
areas.note: Central dense street-block sector north of the town-centre corridor; rough internal boundaries.

areas.name: Gyártelep
areas.note: Factory-adjacent historical built-up blocks distinguished from the larger industrial development area.

areas.name: Hétestelep
areas.note: Housing/industrial edge sector; rough boundary following the visible strip southeast of the former main works.

areas.name: Újhétes
areas.note: Small neighbouring built-up strip south of Hétestelep, estimated from map street fabric.

areas.name: Újtelep
areas.note: Built-up area near the source action-areaX; its actual road fabric supplies the broad extent, with approximate side separators.

areas.name: Kiserdőalja
areas.note: Housing strip next to the purple development area; source action label confirms the locality but is not asserted to cover its full extent.

areas.name: Kisamerika
areas.note: Small historic residential block north of Nagyamerika, manual fine separator on the municipal road map.

areas.name: Nagyamerika
areas.note: Neighbouring southern estate block, manually separated from Kisamerika; not a claim of parcel-level boundary precision.

areas.name: Táncsicstelep
areas.note: Historic housing block at the central valley transition; estimated outline follows visible block edges.

areas.name: Velencetelep
areas.note: Northern industrial/housing slope sector. The source includes a Velence-telep development area but the quarter estimate follows broader visible fabric.

areas.name: Istenmező
areas.note: Built-up strip at the western edge of the large industrial area; internal limits are a coarse interpretation.

areas.name: Falu
areas.note: Old village/city-core housing sector on the southeast side of the orange centre zone, guided by actual street-block pattern.

areas.name: Kenderszer
areas.note: Southern residential valley strip visible on both page49 satellite and page54 street map; broad built-up extent retained.

areas.name: Egyházvölgy
areas.note: Valley housing/road corridor east of Hódoscsépány; hand outline follows the visible narrow settlement pattern.

areas.name: Mogyorósvölgy
areas.note: Adjoining southeastern valley/hillside sector; approximate contour inferred from the street and terrain context.

areas.name: Karu
areas.note: Southern valley sector seen in the regional background; rough road/landscape-based boundary, not the development polygon.

areas.name: Cipó
areas.note: Built-up slope north-east of Hódoscsépány; broad sector from the municipal base map with inferred joins.

areas.name: Hódoscsépány
areas.note: Northern built-up settlement in the combined Hódoscsépány-Somsály source area; broad outline includes private-house streets omitted by the development action.

areas.name: Somsály
areas.note: Southern mining-village valley in the combined source map; approximate outer built-up edge follows the printed valley extent and adjacent roads.

areas.name: Tábla
areas.note: Northern Sajóvárkony-Tábla residential/road sector; coarse map partition using the named locality and surrounding actual blocks.

areas.name: Dankótelep
areas.note: Small residential/industrial edge within the eastern built-up area; source map gives physical context, internal limits are manually inferred.
